habit.description: After the first hit you block, the Tanuki grabs (60%). Break the throw.

notes: Tanuki (T0): Ryo's normals, generic throw and starters, plus the one copied special (T2-T4) through special:copied, which resolves to the special locked at T1 (YOK-94); no special id is named here. Habit (throws after one blocked hit, the first blockstun it sees, 60%): the 60% throw was confirmed by the designer on 2026-10-11 (AM4); the trigger was reworded to one blocked hit by AM14 (2026-10-21, YOK-177). The habit id throws-at-a-turtle is kept so code and tests stay untouched. Y5 raises aggression_bias at runtime. YOK-57 (proposed, needs Rules Lawyer and the designer): ex_use 40% when the copied special has an EX and a bar shows; burst_use 50% from the second hit of a combo.
